# Queue board

A walk-in repair cafe wants a screen that shows the queue. A volunteer at the door adds a visitor (first name and the item to repair); repairers take the next visitor; the screen shows who is waiting and who is being helped.

First version: add a visitor, take the next visitor, mark a repair finished, and a board page that refreshes on its own.
Later: text-message alerts when a visitor's turn is near.
